outcome: Time to postpartum urinary retention resolution
cohort: Individuals with postpartum urinary retention (bladder volume of >150 mL) up to 6 hours after vaginal or cesarean delivery
finding: Intermittent catheterization for postpartum urinary retention was associated with quicker resolution and a higher satisfaction rate compared to indwelling catheterization, without increasing complication rates.
mod_finding: This study compared intermittent catheterization to continuous catheterization for postpartum urinary retention and did not report on mode of delivery.
